sources.summary: Set along a tranquil riverbank in the suburbs of Riga, Latvia, the BPROM Private Residence pays tribute to Baltic ethnography, blending ancient local traditions with the comforts of modern living. Designed as a summer holiday home, the project includes a family residence and a guest house with a sauna.
